newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT--Swire upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT--Swire upgraded to buy.

text.p: SBC Warburg Asia Ltd said it had upgraded its recommendation for conglomerate Swire Pacific Ltd to buy from sell.

"With the aviation operations being increasingly marginalised, Swire's share price performance will be driven largely by the outlook for its property arm," analysts Kam-ming Wong and Alwyn Pang said in a recent report.

Compared with listed property-investment companies, Swire has the best possible combination of high, steady, rental income growth during 1990-98, and by 1998 the company is expected to become the largest (listed) landlord in Hong Kong, they added.

Investors also should focus on the implied NAV (net asset value) discount for Swire excluding Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd and Hongkong Aircraft Engineering Co Ltd (HAECO), which is estimated at 12 percent, the report said.
This is derived from Swire's adjusted share price of HK$56.77 and an NAV of HK$64.58, after excluding the contents of Cathay and HAECO.
The analysts gave a target price of HK$79.20 based on 1.6 times price/book value of Swire ex-Cathay and HAECO.
Swire was unchanged at HK$73.25 around midday on Monday.
